description: Measured normal boiling points, for training the learned expert that answers where Joback group contribution has no groups to match.
provenance: Compiled from the chemicals package, restricted to sources that carry a measurement or a reference equation of state: HEOS, CRC_INORG, CRC_ORG, COMMON_CHEMISTRY and WEBBOOK. JOBACK is excluded deliberately - it is the primary source for roughly a quarter of the boiling points in that package, and training on it would teach this model to imitate the very method it exists to cover for. The fifty calibration compounds are excluded by InChIKey so the benchmark stays held out.
